definitions.explanation: A removable or hinged piece that covers an opening or container.

examples.english: Please put the lid on the pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦ペットボトル→ペットボトル：05605_pettobotoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蓋|ふた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|あ}かない→開く：00689_aku⟧。
examples.english: I can't open the bottle cap.

examples.japanese: {蓋|ふた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けたら→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I opened the lid, there was a nice smell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦{箱|ばこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蓋|ふた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{閉|し}まらない→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧。
examples.english: The lid of the lunch box won't close properly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蓋|ふた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けると→開ける：00563_akeru⟧、⟦{炊|た}きたて→炊き立て：15234_takitate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: When I opened the lid of the rice cooker, the nice smell of freshly cooked rice filled the air.

notes:
{蓋|ふた} is a general-purpose word for any removable cover or lid on a container. It applies to pots, bottles, boxes, jars, and more.

WRITING:
The kanji {蓋|ふた} is common but hiragana ふた is also widely used, especially in casual writing.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {蓋|ふた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put on a lid
- {蓋|ふた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a lid
- {蓋|ふた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧: to close a lid
- {蓋|ふた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to remove a lid
{蓋|ふた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦みない→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ means "you won't know until you try" (literally, until you open the lid).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦キャップ→キャップ：05435_kyappu⟧: cap (for bottles, pens)
- ⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧: cover (broader, often for protective covers)
- ⟦{栓|せん}→栓：19366_sen⟧: plug, stopper (for corks, bath drains)
